name: Manchester City Council

departments.name: Licensing
departments.notes: Handles Licensing Act 2003 (alcohol, entertainment, late night refreshment) and Gambling Act 2005 premises. Register viewable by appointment 9am-5pm. Statement of Licensing Policy 2021-26 available. Out of hours (after 8pm): 0161 234 5004 for emergency noise or premises trading issues.

departments.name: Street Trading
departments.notes: Two types: Street Trader Licence (City Centre/Inner Ring Road) and Street Trader Consent (remaining streets). Some prohibited streets where no trading allowed. Need to consider parking restrictions and land ownership before applying.

departments.name: Planning
departments.notes: Applications submitted via national Planning Portal. Planning Committee contact: 0161 234 3235 (Members Services). Planning and Highways Committee meets regularly for major applications.

departments.name: Building Control
departments.notes: Currently experiencing substantial delays due to staff shortages. Alternative building control providers may be considered. Office hours: 9am-4pm Monday to Friday.

departments.name: Highways
departments.notes: TRO/TTRO applications. Minimum charge for event road closures: £167. Road closures for works: minimum £2,522. Six week lead-in period for TTRO applications. Over 18 months requires London Gazette publication.

departments.name: Environmental Health
departments.notes: No public email - contact via online form only. Response within two working days. Handles flytipping, noise, pests, air pollution, litter, food safety, graffiti.

departments.name: Public Protection
departments.notes: Responsible authority for licensing consultations. Alternative phone 0161 952 8200 for Local Authority/hospital/university applications.

departments.name: Trading Standards
departments.notes: Responsible authority for licensing matters. Handles consumer protection and trading regulations.

departments.name: Property Licensing
departments.notes: HMO licensing mandatory for 5+ persons, 2+ households. Processing target: 60 days. Selective Licensing Scheme 3 covers parts of Cheetham, Crumpsall, Harpurhey, Longsight, Miles Platting & Newton Heath, Moss Side (May 2025-May 2030). HMO fee from £1,321 (5 occupants). Selective fee from £798.
